key_expressions: Let me know immediately if the schedule changes,
I will coordinate with the local team,

A: How far along are you with the business trip preparations?
It looks like the flight schedule has changed a bit.
I’ll share the confirmed time shortly.
B: Oh, yes. I also received a notification a moment ago.
It seems the departure time was moved up slightly.
Once you share the update, I’ll reflect it in the schedule.

A: Have you finished preparing the materials for the onsite meeting?
Some parts seemed to require updates with more recent information.
Would you like me to help revise those sections?
B: Yes, I thought the same — a few areas definitely need updates.
There’s actually quite a bit to revise.
If possible, could you summarize the key items first?

A: Have you printed all the required travel documents?
The invitation letter and itinerary are essential to bring.
If you need extra copies, I can print them for you.
B: I have the invitation letter ready, but not the itinerary yet.
If you could print it, that would help a lot.
In return, I’ll take care of preparing the hotel vouchers.

A: How much packing have you done so far?
I heard the weather there has been unpredictable.
It might be good to bring a light jacket just in case.
B: Yes, I heard that too — apparently it suddenly got colder.
I haven’t packed a jacket yet, but I should add one.
Thanks for the reminder!

A: Have you confirmed the time for the first meeting with the local team?
I heard there might be some adjustments needed.
If necessary, I can reach out to them directly.
B: I haven’t received the exact time yet.
But yes, if adjustments are needed, your help would be great.
I’ll let you know as soon as the time is confirmed.

A: Have you settled all the travel expenses?
Let me know if anything needs to be prepaid.
I can submit the approval request right away.
B: Not everything yet — a few items are still pending.
The transportation expenses in particular need another review.
I’ll整理everything and share an update soon.

A: This trip’s schedule looks quite tight — are you okay with it?
Some segments may not have enough travel time between them.
If needed, I can review the route again.
B: I noticed that too — a few transitions look too close.
It might become an issue if meetings run long.
A review of the route would be very helpful.

A: Have you created a list of things you'll need onsite?
I’m a bit worried we might miss something related to meeting equipment.
Would you like me to prepare a checklist and send it to you?
B: I haven’t completed it yet — I was also worried something might be missing.
A checklist would make things much easier.
Yes, please send it when it’s ready!

A: It seems the hotel check-in may be later than expected.
Do you think this will affect the schedule?
If needed, I can inform the local team in advance.
B: Oh, then we might have less time to prepare for the first meeting.
It could be a bit tight, but I think it’s manageable.
Still, informing the local team would be a good idea.

A: Shall we go through the full itinerary one last time before departure?
It looks like most preparations are complete now.
I’ll send you the final checklist as well.
B: Sounds good — I think we’re almost ready.
Having a checklist will give me peace of mind.
Send it over when you can; I’ll check it right away.
